song_id.Description: Unique identifier of the music stimulus presented during the experiment.

Song Catergory.Description: Emotion category assigned to the music stimulus according to the intended affective label.

Valence.Description: Participant self-reported valence rating after listening to the music stimulus.

Arousal.Description: Participant self-reported arousal rating after listening to the music stimulus.

Likeability.Description: Participant self-reported degree of liking for the music stimulus.

Familiarity.Description: Participant self-reported familiarity with the music stimulus.

Remark.Description: Additional notes associated with the trial or recording.

Levels.missing EEG data: EEG recording for this trial is unavailable.
